title: EVE Hub [Fisch]
features:
Fisch Script
🎣 Fishing Automation
Auto Equip Rod - Automatically equips fishing rods from inventory
Auto Shake - Automatically completes shake minigame
Auto Reel (Safe Method) - Smooth and safe fish reeling
Auto Reel (Instant Catch) - Instantly catches fish after 3 seconds
Auto Cast - Continuously casts fishing rod

💰 Advanced Auto-Selling System
Auto Sell Equipped Item - Continuously sells equipped fish
Auto Sell Inventory - Automatically sells all inventory items
Auto Sell Everything - Sells both equipped and inventory simultaneously
Manual Sell Options - One-click selling buttons

📊 Item Management
Auto Appraise Equipped - Continuously appraises held items for value

🛒 Complete In-Game Shop
20 Boats & Watercraft - Instant purchase of all boats (Rowboat, Pirate Ship, Submarine, etc.)
16 Fishing Rods - Buy any rod instantly (Training, Mythical, Midas, etc.)
3 Diving Gear Items - Basic/Advanced gear and Fish Radar
Special Items - Fireworks and more

🗺️ Advanced Teleportation
6 Major Island Teleports - Ancient Isle, Sunstone, Vertigo Dip, The Bunker, Birch Cay
Best Fishing Spot - Teleport to optimal fishing location
5 Favorite Position Slots - Save and teleport to any 5 custom locations
Instant Teleport - No loading screens

🛠️ Utility Features

Freeze Character - Anti-fall cage keeps you stationary while AFK fishing
Position Management - Save up to 5 favorite spots for quick access

✨ Quality of Life

Clean Modern UI 
No Detection Risk 
Discord Community
Regular Updates 

📱 User Interface
4 Organized Tabs - Main, Shop, Teleports, Miscellaneous
Easy Toggle System - Enable/disable features instantly
